objects.name: Analytic 2171
objects.description: Real-time network monitoring identifies a source generating Industrial Control System (ICS) discovery broadcasts or sequential connection attempts across the full IP range of a device subnet, from a source not in the approved engineering/Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) inventory. Documented in the PIPEDREAM/INCONTROLLER toolset's CODECALL module for EtherNet/IP device discovery. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
